base_note: d9404e90 is the nearest commit; the scratch copy is an rsync snapshot of the WORKING TREE (the state the deployed stack runs, including uncommitted product changes) taken at run start.
doc: Seeded-defect patch set for `run.py --mutation-test`. Each patch applies with `git apply` to the scratch working-tree copy (never the live tree), is compiled by a targeted incremental `cargo build -p api-server`, and must be caught by the listed probes in the mutant run through failing checks that passed in the clean control run. Families: authz, hostile, state, resource, errors, pipeline, invariants.

mutations.description: GET /v1/contacts/:id stops filtering by tenant_id (cross-tenant IDOR read)
require_scopes() becomes a no-op: every tenant role/write scope is admitted
PATCH /v1/campaigns/:id drops the editable-status guard: editing a sent campaign returns 200
The email-verification token is no longer consumed: a replay succeeds (single-use broken)
ui-foundation::shell::html_escape becomes the identity: stored/served HTML escapes nothing
The CRLF guards on the mail subject AND custom header values are dropped (header injection admitted)
The public auth rate limiter's per-minute bound becomes u64::MAX (no 429 ever)
The email_queue insert loop inserts nothing: accepted sends never reach the worker/Mailpit
The suppression check is skipped: sends to suppressed recipients are accepted
Contact email validation is skipped: an empty/invalid required field is accepted
